settings.question: How much does a tire rotation cost in Calgary?
settings.answer: A tire rotation at Prince Tires is a flat $60 for most vehicles, and $100 for dual-rear-wheel (dually) and heavy-duty trucks. You'll see the exact price when you book online.

settings.question: How often should I rotate my tires?
settings.answer: Every 8,000 to 12,000 km is the general rule — roughly every other oil change. An easy way to remember it in Calgary is to have it done at your seasonal tire changeover, spring and fall.

settings.question: Why does rotating tires matter?
settings.answer: Front tires carry the steering and most of the braking load, so they wear faster than the rears. Left alone, you'd replace the fronts long before the rears are worn out. Rotating on a regular pattern evens out the wear, so you get the full life from all four and replace them as a set.

settings.question: Do I still need rotation if I run separate winter and summer tires?
settings.answer: Yes. Swapping seasonal sets isn't the same as rotating — each set still wears unevenly front-to-rear over its own season. We can rotate each set as part of the changeover; just ask when you book.

settings.question: How long does a tire rotation take?
settings.answer: About 30 minutes for most vehicles. Book a slot online, drop the vehicle, and you're back on the road quickly — same-day service is usually available.

settings.heading: Tire Rotation Calgary
settings.subheading: Front tires wear out faster than rears — a lot faster. Prince Tires rotates your tires so all four wear evenly and last longer. About 30 minutes, same-day at our SW Calgary shop.
settings.pricing_intro: Your front and rear tires don't wear at the same rate — the fronts handle steering and most of the braking, so they wear faster. A rotation moves each tire to a new position on a set pattern, so the wear evens out and the whole set lasts longer. It's a flat $60 for most vehicles — cars, SUVs, vans, EVs, pickups and trailers — and $100 for dual-rear-wheel (dually) and heavy-duty trucks.
